opening.argument: The video presents a concrete instructional walkthrough for adding a Vanilla Mastercard gift card as an Amazon payment method. It directs viewers to the account menu, identifies the “Add payment method” option, and then describes the “Add Card” control as sequential tutorial steps. The narration also explains that the postal code registered on the Vanilla Mastercard gift card is relevant to selecting the matching address, while the displayed Amazon screens show payment-management and address-selection options. The disclosed affiliate arrangement and separate Cash App referral are not shown to be connected to deceptive activity or to the card tutorial. The evidence therefore supports an educational technology and operational demonstration, without establishing deceptive conduct, losses, or an outcome beyond the demonstrated instructions.
